title: Alternate suit 2: Don Cherry sky-blue daisy suit and ivory tie
retention: Owner requested retaining both suits as Alternate suit 1 and Alternate suit 2 on 2026-10-18.
namingHistory: Generated under the working name Alternate suit 1; saved as Alternate suit 2 at owner request. Exact historical prompts and references are preserved; catalogReferences identify current matching artwork.

clothingReference.description: Don Cherry's actual sky-blue suit with white daisies, yellow centres and an ivory tie, photographed on Coach's Corner
clothingReference.pageTitle: The Best Of Don Cherry: Fashion Edition
clothingReference.author: Courtney French
clothingReference.adaptation: Fabric pattern, palette and ivory tie adapted onto the existing robot jacket cut. Human anatomy, double-breasted construction, vest and boutonniere were not copied. Reference photograph is local research only, not distributed with the artwork.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Create ONE transparent PNG production character cutout, full untrimmed 1254 x 1254 canvas.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: original Don robot default pose. Input 2 is a REAL CLOTHING REFERENCE: Don Cherry on the right wearing his sky-blue daisy suit on Coach's Corner. Change ONLY the robot's jacket fabric and tie to directly adapt that actual outfit.
Match the photo faithfully: clear sky-blue/aqua-blue cloth, scattered large simple WHITE DAISIES with many narrow petals and small golden-yellow centres, comfortably spaced with plenty of plain blue visible between flowers. No leaves, stems, scrolls, paisley, pink, additional patterns, outlines around petals or invented ornaments. The flowers should look like the photographed printed fabric, not ornate brocade. Ivory satin tie with subtle diagonal woven texture as in the photograph. Retain the robot's existing jacket cut/lapels, white shirt, cuffs, pocket square and black lapel microphone. Do not copy the human anatomy, pose, desk, logo or cohost from the photograph. Do not add a boutonniere or vest.
Preserve every other part of input 1: silver faceted robot face, cyan screen eyes, white sculpted metallic hair, connected white moustache and broad goatee, exact closed-mouth seam, gaze and stern expression, hands/fingers clasped low, original head and shoulder anchors, body silhouette, scale, square margins and lower cutoff. Same polished detailed cel-shaded illustration with sharp black edges and silver shading. Left host facing slightly screen-right, never mirrored.
True transparent alpha background and gaps between arms and body. No desk, chair, scenery, floor, cast shadow, text, labels or watermark. This is Alternate suit 1, a nonholiday wardrobe. One pose only.
assets.postprocessing: Original generated PNG preserved byte-for-byte. WebP quality 94 at 1254 and 640 pixels. AVIF uses the existing coachs:assets recipe.
